title: AuthStatusData
description:
`auth status` result — per-SESSION access health (each probed under that session's own
credential), the active agent's trigger health, and the reporting posture. **INFERRED**
(additive-only).

hook_armed.description: Whether the session-start auto-update trigger is armed in the active harness's config.

principal.description: The principal the first successful probe answered with.

reporting.description: Per-workspace reporting posture, read from local state (no network).

server.description: The server base of the first live session, for orientation.

signed_in.description: Whether any live session exists (the signed-in state).

workspaces.description: One row per session this installation holds.

AuthReportingStatus.description:
One workspace's reporting posture in an [`AuthStatusData`] (from the local sync-status
document). **INFERRED** (additive-only).

stale.description: Whether the last delivery is older than the window (the sessions page shows the same).

AuthWorkspaceStatus.description: One session's access health in an [`AuthStatusData`]. **INFERRED** (additive-only).

credential.description: Whether this session's credential is stored locally (always true for a live session row).

health.description:
The probe verdict: `healthy` / `pending — awaiting owner approval` / `no access — ended,
removed, or gone` / `unreachable` / `ended`.

role.description: The role the probe answered (healthy only).
